name: 3.3 V LDO regulator, SOT-223
summary: Turns 4.75–12 V into a steady 3.3 V at up to 800 mA.

faq.a: Turns 4.75–12 V into a steady 3.3 V at up to 800 mA.
1.3 V typical, as listed for this part.
Pin 1 on the fixed 3.3 V part. Pin 2 is the output, and the tab is the output. Pin 3 is the input.
A loose SOT-223 in an antistatic bag.

description: AMS1117-3.3 low-dropout linear regulator in SOT-223. 800 mA output, 1.3 V typical dropout. Used to feed 3.3 V logic such as an ESP32. Sourced from Hall Road, Lahore.
